sources.entry: Focus Firewall - A minimalist focus app to block social media and other distractions during work. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6476942786?pt=124015613&ct=awesome-mac&mt=8&platform=mac)

summary.name: Focus Firewall
summary.one_liner: Focus Firewall is a Mac app that blocks distracting websites and apps on a schedule while you work, with pausing allowed after Touch ID confirmation.
use_cases: Stay focused while programming, writing or studying
Block social media and news sites during work hours
Stop doomscrolling and binge-watching on a Mac
Schedule automatic blocking for work days
Review time spent on distracting websites
summary.what_it_does: Focus Firewall blocks listed websites and apps on macOS while a work session is active, showing blocked sites as unreachable and cutting blocked apps off from the internet. Its default list includes 155+ websites and 9 messaging apps, and users can add, edit, disable or delete entries and allowlist subdomains. A single schedule turns blocking on and off automatically, and pausing is allowed for a chosen duration with Touch ID or password confirmation. The Browsing Report shows time per distracting site by hour and gives a daily summary, with data kept on the Mac. It works with many browsers without extensions, and offers Shortcuts control.
notable: Works with many browsers (Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Arc, Edge and others) without browser extensions
Schedule-based blocking that turns on and off automatically
Browsing Report with hourly time per distracting site, stored locally
No sign-up or tracking; Touch ID required to stop or pause blocking
caveats: Requires a subscription or one-time purchase after a 7-day free trial (monthly $2.99, annual $19.99, lifetime $29.99 listed on page)
May not work properly alongside VPNs or enterprise MDM software such as Jamf, SentinelOne or CarbonBlack
